jobs.description:
Senior Writing Systems Engineer BSA - Bobst Mex SA Apply now Shape the future of industrial inkjet printing At BOBST, we are redefining the future of packaging through advanced industrial printing technologies. As a global leader in packaging equipment and services, we combine Swiss engineering excellence with digital transformation to deliver high-performance production systems worldwide. To strengthen our R&D team, we are looking for a Senior Writing Systems Engineer who will play a key role in developing and optimizing next-generation industrial inkjet printing systems for demanding production and application environments. Your mission As a senior technical expert, you will own and drive the performance of our writing systems at the heart of our digital printing platforms. You will work on highly complex multidisciplinary challenges involving printheads, fluidics, motion systems, electronics, software, print applications, and industrial process stability to ensure outstanding image quality, robustness, uptime, and production performance in real customer environments. The role requires a strong connection between technology development and real industrial application realities, including substrates, inks, workflows, operator usage, and production constraints. Your mission As a senior technical expert, you will own and drive the performance of our writing systems , at the heart of our digital printing platforms. You will operate at the crossroads of mechanics, electronics, software and fluid physics , ensuring that our machines deliver outstanding print quality, reliability, and industrial performance. 
• Responsibilities Drive innovation & system performace Drive the design and optimization of industrial inkjet writing system architectures.

Define and challenge performance targets related to: printhead behavior,

Act as technical owner from concept to product launch

Ensure alignment between performance, quality, cost and manufacturability

Translate business needs into robust engineering solutions

Develop physical and empirical models (fluid dynamics, drop formation, thermal behavior)

Design and execute advanced experiments (DOE)

Analyze data to improve system behavior and reliability

Senior Writing Systems Engineer BSA – Bobst Mex SA Jetzt bewerben Gestalten Sie die Zukunft des industriellen Tintenstrahldrucks. Bei BOBST definieren wir die Zukunft der Verpackung durch fortschrittliche industrielle Drucktechnologien neu. Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Verpackungsanlagen und -dienstleistungen kombinieren wir Schweizer Ingenieurskunst mit digitaler Transformation, um weltweit leistungsstarke Produktionssysteme bereitzustellen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Forschungs- und Entwicklungsteams suchen wir einen Senior Writing Systems Engineer, der eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Entwicklung und Optimierung industrieller Tintenstrahldrucksysteme der nächsten Generation für anspruchsvolle Produktions- und Anwendungsumgebungen spielt. Ihre Mission Als leitender technischer Experte sind Sie Eigentümer und treiben die Leistung unserer Schreibsysteme im Herzen unserer Digitaldruckplattformen voran. Sie arbeiten an hochkomplexen multidisziplinären Herausforderungen in den Bereichen Druckköpfe, Fluidik, Bewegungssysteme, Elektronik, Software, Druckanwendungen und industrielle Prozessstabilität, um herausragende Bildqualität, Robustheit, Betriebszeit und Produktionsleistung in realen Kundenumgebungen sicherzustellen. Die Rolle erfordert eine starke Verbindung zwischen der Technologieentwicklung und der realen industriellen Anwendungsrealität, einschließlich Substraten, Tinten, Arbeitsabläufen, Bedienernutzung und Produktionsbeschränkungen. Dessinateur bâtiment et technique BSA - Bobst Mex SA Postuler En tant que spécialiste du dessin technique au sein de notre équipe Workplace & Facility Services, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'établissement et la mise à jour des plans d'architecture et techniques mais également dans l’aménagement de nos espaces de travail. Vous collaborez étroitement avec notre Spécialiste Technique Senior, les chefs de projets et le Manager du service pour concevoir des plans fiables, précis et indispensables au fonctionnement quotidien de notre site (REVIT/AUTOCAD). 
• Votre mission : créer, mettre à jour et garantir la qualité des plans architecturaux, techniques, d’aménagement et de sécurité, afin d’offrir à nos collaborateurs un environnement moderne, conforme et adapté à leurs besoins. 
• Vos responsabilités principales Elaborer et mettre à jour les plans architecturaux et techniques Réaliser des plans architecturaux, techniques et schémas de principe selon charte graphique et normes SIA.

Effectuer les prises de mesures sur site et assurer la mise à jour des plans “tels que construits”.

Actualiser la charte graphique.

Garantir l’application des standards (internes et externes) et des bonnes pratiques.

Concevoir et actualiser les plans d’aménagement des espaces de travail selon les exigences OLT3, EHS et autres normes légales ou internes.

Produire et maintenir les plans de sécurité incendie et les affiches d’évacuation en lien avec l'équipe sécurité du campus.

Intégrer les plans et générer les rapports nécessaires au pilotage du service.

Participer au développement de l’outil.

Disegnatore edile e tecnico BSA - Bobst Mex SA Candidati In qualità di specialista in disegno tecnico all'interno del nostro team Workplace & Facility Services, svolgi un ruolo chiave nella definizione e nell'aggiornamento dei piani architettonici e tecnici ma anche nella disposizione dei nostri spazi di lavoro. Lavori a stretto contatto con il nostro specialista tecnico senior, i project manager e il responsabile del servizio per progettare piani affidabili e precisi che sono essenziali per il funzionamento quotidiano del nostro sito (REVIT/AUTOCAD).
• La vostra missione: creare, aggiornare e garantire la qualità dei progetti architettonici, tecnici, di layout e di sicurezza, per offrire ai nostri dipendenti un ambiente moderno, conforme e adatto alle loro esigenze.
• Le vostre principali responsabilità Sviluppare e aggiornare progetti architettonici e tecnici. Produrre progetti architettonici, tecnici e schemi di principio secondo la carta grafica e gli standard SIA.

Effettua misurazioni sul posto e assicurati che i piani "as built" siano aggiornati.

Aggiornare la carta grafica.

Garantire l’applicazione degli standard (interni ed esterni) e delle buone pratiche.

Progetta e aggiorna i piani di layout dello spazio di lavoro in base a OLT3, requisiti EHS e altri standard legali o interni.

Produrre e mantenere piani di sicurezza antincendio e manifesti di evacuazione in collaborazione con il team di sicurezza del campus.

Integra i piani e genera la reportistica necessaria alla gestione del servizio.

Partecipare allo sviluppo dello strumento.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Building and technical draftsman BSA - Bobst Mex SA Apply As a technical drawing specialist within our Workplace & Facility Services team, you play a key role in establishing and updating architectural and technical plans but also in the layout of our workspaces. You work closely with our Senior Technical Specialist, project managers and the Service Manager to design reliable, precise plans that are essential to the daily operation of our site (REVIT/AUTOCAD).
• Your mission: create, update and guarantee the quality of architectural, technical, layout and security plans, in order to offer our employees a modern environment, compliant and adapted to their needs.
• Your main responsibilities Develop and update architectural and technical plans Produce architectural, technical plans and principle diagrams according to graphic charter and SIA standards.

Take measurements on site and ensure “as built” plans are updated.

Update the graphic charter.

Guarantee the application of standards (internal and external) and good practices.

Design and update workspace layout plans according to OLT3, EHS requirements and other legal or internal standards.

Produce and maintain fire safety plans and evacuation posters in conjunction with the campus safety team.

Integrate plans and generate reports necessary to manage the service.

Participate in the development of the tool.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bau- und technischer Zeichner BSA - Bobst Mex SA Bewerben Als Spezialist für technisches Zeichnen in unserem Workplace & Facility Services-Team spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Erstellung und Aktualisierung architektonischer und technischer Pläne, aber auch bei der Gestaltung unserer Arbeitsbereiche. Sie arbeiten eng mit unserem Senior Technical Specialist, den Projektmanagern und dem Service Manager zusammen, um zuverlässige und präzise Pläne zu entwerfen, die für den täglichen Betrieb unserer Website (REVIT/AUTOCAD) unerlässlich sind.
• Ihre Mission: Erstellung, Aktualisierung und Gewährleistung der Qualität von Architektur-, Technik-, Layout- und Sicherheitsplänen, um unseren Mitarbeitern ein modernes, konformes und an ihre Bedürfnisse angepasstes Umfeld zu bieten.
• Ihre Hauptaufgaben: Entwickeln und aktualisieren Sie architektonische und technische Pläne. Erstellen Sie architektonische, technische Pläne und Prinzipdiagramme gemäß der Grafikcharta und den SIA-Standards.

Nehmen Sie Messungen vor Ort vor und stellen Sie sicher, dass die „as-built“-Pläne aktualisiert werden.

Aktualisieren Sie die grafische Charta.

Garantieren Sie die Anwendung von Standards (intern und extern) und bewährten Praktiken.

Entwerfen und aktualisieren Sie Arbeitsplatzlayoutpläne gemäß OLT3, EHS-Anforderungen und anderen gesetzlichen oder internen Standards.

Erstellen und pflegen Sie gemeinsam mit dem Sicherheitsteam des Campus Brandschutzpläne und Evakuierungsplakate.

Integrieren Sie Pläne und erstellen Sie Berichte, die für die Verwaltung des Dienstes erforderlich sind.

Beteiligen Sie sich an der Entwicklung des Tools.

jobs.title: Flagship Event Manager
jobs.description:
Flagship Event Manager BSA - Bobst Mex SA Apply now Want to shape high-impact customer experiences that engage customers and showcase innovation? This role will be located in one of our BOBST entity in EUROPE. As Flagship Event Manager, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of BOBST's flagship customer events, ensuring execution excellence through strong project governance, cross-functional coordination, budget management, and impact measurement. Key 
• Responsibilities Lead the planning and execution of flagship customer events.

Manage event timelines, milestones, and end-to-end delivery to ensure execution excellence.

Establish project governance and prepare and lead steering committee meetings.

Monitor project progress, manage risks and dependencies, and facilitate timely decision-making.

Align and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders, including Product Lines, Industries, Sales, and Regional MarCom teams.

Foster effective collaboration and manage project communications across all involved parties.

Manage event budgets, procurement activities, and agency selection and performance.

Monitor spending and forecasts while ensuring compliance with approved budgets.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Flagship Event Manager BSA - Bobst Mex SA Candidati ora Vuoi dare forma a esperienze cliente di grande impatto che coinvolgano i clienti e mostrino l'innovazione? Questo ruolo sarà situato in una delle nostre entità BOBST in EUROPA. In qualità di Flagship Event Manager, guiderai la consegna end-to-end degli eventi di punta dei clienti BOBST, garantendo l'eccellenza dell'esecuzione attraverso una forte governance del progetto, coordinamento interfunzionale, gestione del budget e misurazione dell'impatto. Chiave
• Responsabilità Guidare la pianificazione e l'esecuzione degli eventi di punta per i clienti.

Gestisci le tempistiche degli eventi, le tappe fondamentali e la consegna end-to-end per garantire l'eccellenza dell'esecuzione.

Stabilire la governance del progetto e preparare e condurre le riunioni del comitato direttivo.

Monitora l'avanzamento del progetto, gestisci i rischi e le dipendenze e facilita il processo decisionale tempestivo.

Allinea e coordina le parti interessate interfunzionali, comprese le linee di prodotto, le industrie, le vendite e i team MarCom regionali.

Promuovere una collaborazione efficace e gestire le comunicazioni di progetto tra tutte le parti coinvolte.

Gestisci i budget degli eventi, le attività di approvvigionamento, la selezione e le prestazioni delle agenzie.

Monitorare le spese e le previsioni garantendo al tempo stesso il rispetto dei budget approvati.
